// diagnostic

E0738

`{holder}` holds a `{tag}` value.

What

`{holder}` holds a `{tag}` value.

Why

`{tag}` is `timing: .Fixed`, and an `Int` (a big integer) or a `Float` takes time that depends on its value.

Fix

Keep the value in a fixed-width type such as `U64` or `[U8]`, or reveal it through a `#Scrub({tag})` function first.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0738: tests/ui/taint/fixed_timing_value_in_int_or_float_is_e0738.stderr.
